doc.title: Lune Touch
device.name: Name
help.controllers: Pair and approve V6 boards for this house. Unapproved boards stay local and do not contribute rooms or heat calls.
help.addController: Add a reachable V6 by hostname or IP. Scan lists boards on the LAN; approve after pairing so Touch may steer them.
help.heatSource: Direct connection to the heat source. Touch publishes weighted house temperature on an interval. Wrong host or templates block delivery.
help.pump: Circulation pump host, port and ESPHome entities for flow, head and power on the house dashboard.
help.weather: Coordinates and max preload boost for forecast-driven room warm-up. Wrong location mis-times west/east exposure.
help.energy: Energy metering is reserved for a later release. No settings here yet.
help.identity: Device name and display idle time. Forecast location is kept when you reset the registry from Service.
help.firmware: Check for updates, install from the network, or upload a .bin. The device reboots when flashing finishes.
help.backup: Export or import settings as JSON. Secrets are never included. Import overwrites coordinator settings on this device.
help.service: Commissioning notes, command log, live diagnostics and destructive registry reset. Restart and OTA stay here — not in the device menu.
help.room: Room name, floor area and which V6 circuits share one comfort sensor. Merged circuits open together.
help.roomFactors: Exterior walls and wind/solar factors steer preload. Include in house temperature when the room should weight the house average.

help.heatHttp: Generic HTTP uses write and read URL templates with {value}, {host}, {port}, and {entity}. Method is POST (fixed in firmware). Request timeout is 2500 ms (fixed).

dash.zone.note: Zone detail is filled by the coordinator at runtime. This reference page shows layout and navigation only.
alert.heatConnBody: Last push failed. House temperature is not updated until the connection works again.
hs.houseTempHint: The measured, weighted house temperature. It is never altered – Odin and Asgard learn from it. Sent while the V6s have granted Touch the lease.
hs.targetSyncHint: Recommended on – also with Odin. When Odin is in control the house target is sent unlifted as a backup, so Asgard has the right target if Odin stops.
hs.odinPlanHint: Uses Odin's heat windows for absorbing and preheating
hs.notSentLease: Not sent – the V6s have not granted Touch the lease
role.reserve: Backup – Odin is in control. Asgard uses the target (unlifted) if Odin stops.
role.reserveNow: Backup – Odin drives the pump now. Asgard uses the target if Odin stops.
role.asgardNow: Active – Asgard regulates itself right now and heats to the target.
role.offOdin: Off – if Odin stops, Asgard uses its own setpoint. Turn sync on.
role.drives: In control – Asgard heats to the target (+{c} °C when needed).
role.off: Off – Asgard does not get the house target.
planG.title: Heating plan
planG.sub: Next 24 hours: Odin's planned heat and Touch's preheating and charging per room
planG.empty: No plan yet – waiting for the forecast and Odin.
planG.aria: Heating plan for the next 24 hours
planG.tipInsufficient: Charging +{c} °C – the floor cannot cover the whole shortfall
hs.mqttHint: Reads Odin's plan and the pump telemetry straight from the broker, so a stopped Asgard is noticed sooner. Touch never publishes, and HTTP is still used if the broker goes away.
hs.mqttPasswordSet: Saved – leave empty to keep it
hs.odinControlHint: Touch temporarily raises Odin's comfort band before wind and cold, and when a room lags. Your own schedule is written back afterwards, and Touch leaves it alone if you change it in Odin.
hs.link.ok: OK – Odin gets data and learns
hs.link.forwarder_off: Asgard is not forwarding to Odin – Odin is not learning
hs.link.telemetry_stale: Odin has no fresh telemetry ({s} min) – Odin is not learning
hs.link.no_room_temperature: Odin gets no room temperature – Odin is not learning
hs.odinStatus.yielded: Paused – the schedule was changed in Odin
hs.odinStatus.rate_limited: Waiting – at most one change per 20 min
hs.odinStatus.schedule_unreadable: Odin's schedule could not be read
hs.route.none: None – Odin follows its own schedule
hs.leversHint: Most boilers and heat pumps without a room sensor regulate on return temperature or a weather curve. Fill in the inputs your source has – Touch sends the same house demand in that form.
hs.testCheckHost: Check host and port, and that the heat source is reachable.
hs.testCheckHttp: Check the endpoint and that the heat source answers.

price.title: Electricity price to Odin
price.enabledHint: Touch sets up Odin's own price, or calculates the price and sends it
price.gridDatahubHint: Vores Elnet, Nettarif C: 5790000610976 and TNT1009. Other grid companies: look up GLN and code in DatahubPricelist on energidataservice.dk.
price.schedHint: Excl. VAT. Each period runs from its hour to the next period; the last one runs past midnight.
price.gridNoneHint: No grid tariff is added. Use this if the tariff is already in the supplier markup.
price.err.spot: The spot price could not be fetched
price.err.grid: The grid tariff could not be fetched – check GLN and tariff code
price.err.energinet: The system tariff could not be fetched
price.err.odin: Odin did not accept the prices
price.err.no_odin_host: No Odin address – set it under Heat source
price.err.clock: Touch does not know the time yet
price.err.other: The price could not be calculated
price.cached: Tariff from the last successful fetch
price.noOdinHost: Set Odin's address under Heat source first.
price.pushPending: Touch has not answered yet – see Status in a moment
price.pushDisabled: Turn on “Send prices to Odin” first
price.inclAll: All-in price in {cur}/kWh incl. tariffs, taxes and VAT.
help.price: Odin plans the heat pump on the electricity price. “Odin fetches itself”: Touch only sets Odin's own price settings (spot from Energy-Charts or ENTSO-E plus Odin's energy tax and VAT per zone, or a fixed price). “Touch calculates”: Touch fetches spot and tariffs, adds tax, markup and VAT in your currency and sends the hourly price to Odin after 14:15 and just after midnight – use it where Odin's table is incomplete, e.g. Denmark (grid tariff, 2026 elafgift).
price.tokenHint: Only needed for ENTSO-E (free at transparency.entsoe.eu). It is stored but never shown again; in “Odin fetches itself” it is also written to Odin.
price.tokenSaved: Saved – type a new one to replace it
price.odinDynamicHint: Odin adds its own energy tax and VAT for the zone and switches to the other source if one fails.
price.odinDkNote: For DK1/DK2 Odin's tax is outdated (0.10 €/kWh instead of the 2026 elafgift of 0.008 DKK) and it has no grid tariff – choose “Touch calculates”.
price.spotEdsHint: Denmark only. Prices in DKK and EUR; the exchange rate comes from the same data.
price.spotEcHint: Free, every zone. Uses ENTSO-E instead if Energy-Charts fails and a token is set.
price.spotEntsoeHint: Needs the ENTSO-E token above. Uses Energy-Charts instead if ENTSO-E fails.
price.applyDefaultsHint: Fills in currency, rate, energy tax, VAT and sources for the zone (Odin's table; Denmark gets the 2026 rates). Nothing changes until you save.
price.defaultsApplied: Defaults for {zone} filled in – save to use them
price.defaultsUnknown: No table entry for {zone}: 0 tax and 21 % VAT filled in
price.systemDatahubHint: Energinet's transmission and system tariff from DataHub (2026: 0.115 DKK/kWh in total).
price.systemFixedHint: Excl. VAT. Use 0 if it is not billed separately.
price.err.datahub_dk_only: DataHub and Energi Data Service only cover Denmark
price.fxHint: Currency per euro. Ignored for EUR; Energi Data Service in DKK uses its own rate.
price.perKwhHint: Amounts are per kWh, excl. VAT.
